reviews.t: Works just like it says it will, a real time saver.
reviews.x: I ordered this gel polish remover hoping it would be easier than having to soak cotton balls and hold on my nails forever to get the polish off.  I had my doubts that it would really work but wanted something easier than my other option. This stuff worked so great! I thought for sure I'd have to scrape the polish and apply numerous coats- it took one coat/time and the polish just peeled off in on piece mostly. I did what it said and roughed up the gel polish and applied the remover- that was it
I love this product! It’s my first time using it. It was super fast compared to other companies. The gel polish glided right off. Easy to use and shipping was very fast.

So this product was interesting. I got a gel manicure for my engagement pictures and the salon did a wonderful job. My manicure lasted over 20 days and then finally began to chip. Which is where this product comes in. So I was skeptical but figured it was worth the $6 risk. It was extremely thick and gummy consistency which made it hard to paint on my nails. But after painted on and waiting a little (30 seconds maybe?) my nails began to tingle which kind of freaked me out. The thing about this p

I have worn gel, shellac or dip nails for years. This product is the only thing that I have found that takes the gel off within about 15 minutes. I add a layer to all 10 fingers, and then add a second layer and then let it sit for 7 to 8 minutes. Probably about 80% comes off on the first attempt. I then put a third layer on the remaining for another five or six minutes and the rest comes off then. It does not work on dip nails and I have not tried it on shellac.  Way better than soaking your fin

I waited a few weeks to open this because I was waiting for all of my other stuff for my gel manicure set to arrive. The first time I did open it though it was a sold chunk in the bottle and the brush was hard as a rock. I couldn’t even return it because I had waited to use it. So so disappointed. Don’t waste your money or time.

This product is only okay at removing gel nail polish. You have to use multiple coats and there isn’t a whole lot in the bottle so you can go through it fairly quickly. I was under-impressed with it but it beats filing off your polish.

reviews.t: It's okay, but I don't know if I would buy it again
reviews.x: This product works okay. It's very thick and goopy, and they tell me that's the way it's supposed to be, but it's very difficult to apply an even coat to your nails. The bottle says to keep it on your nails for 5 to 6 minutes, the product description Amazon has says 8 to 10 minutes. It definitely takes at least 10 minutes, but it does eventually come off. I don't know if I would buy it again, because of how thick and goopy it is, because I don't think I'm going to get very many uses out of the b

reviews.t: Do not buy!!! Ruined my nails
reviews.x: This stuff is awful . Completely ate away at my nails and ruined them causing them to be weak and split, I’m so upset , you also can’t return it. DO NOT RUIN YOUR NAILS OR WASTE YOUR $$

reviews.t: The easiest way to remove gel polish at home without damaging the nail!
reviews.x: This product is so easy to use and it gets the job done.  You buff off the top, shiny coat of the gel polish, paint on a thick coat of this remover, wait a few minutes and then wipe off the polish.  No beat up, rough finish to the nail once the polish is removed.  I will be buying more of this.  It's a game changer for me!
Fastest color remover! Love it. Comes out clumpy but I think that is the purpose. It works in minutes. Even after I forgot to buff the top layer of my gel polish.
Didn't really get the gel polish off, just made it super sticky. I would much rather recommend just taking the time to soak them in acetone.
Took forever to bubble and barely got my gelish polish off I ended up filing off my polish
Worked really well. Had to use 2 coats but removed gel very easily
Super genial, facil de usar y retira rapido el esmalte permanente.

reviews.t: Works way better than the soak off method.
reviews.x: I love gel polish but I have always hated the removal process. Leaving clamps or wraps or tinfoil on my nails with acetone for 10-20 minutes always bothered me. It took forever and it never seemed to work well which left me to file it off or peel it. My nails hated me when I removed gel so I looked for a better option.  When I say this product saved my nails, I mean it. Just file off as usual, apply this like polish and let it sit for less than 10 minutes. It starts to bubble and comes right off

Considering that I was trying to find a good alternative to gel nail polish remover (that stinks of alcohol), I'm surprised how well it comes off! Keep in mind though that you have to be patient with its magic. You also have to file down the polish apparently. My polishes are usually thick, so I had to apply this twice in order to remove it effectively with the spatula thing. (You can refer to the picture to see how I usually do my nails, not plain.) Overall, wish I would've got the bundle becau

I hoped I could skip using acetone to remove my no chip. The reviews were mixed so I decided to try it myself. I could get over the gooiness of the polish. Even the tight feeling of it after it was applied. It took way too long to do anything and when it did there was still too much scraping involved. I have a very minimal sense of smell and the smell was turning my headache into a migraine. I would be cautious. Does not break no chip polish apart like it shows at all.

So easy to use! The gel remover works in far less time than soaking my nails or wrapping them in soaked cotton balls and foil. The gel only took minutes.  I did need to apply the gel on my left hand twice but I don’t think I applied enough initially. I applied a thicker coat on my right hand and my polish wiped right off. There was a slight tingle as expected but lasted a very short time. Highly recommend!

So easy to use! The gel remover works in far less time than soaking my nails or wrapping them in soaked cotton balls and foil. The gel only took minutes.  I did need to apply the gel on my left hand twice but I don’t think I applied enough initially. I applied a thicker coat on my right hand and my polish wiped right off. There was a slight tingle as expected but lasted a very short time. Highly recommend!

I bought this in order to remove the gel nail polish on my toes before going to the salon. I also bought some salon quality tools that helps to scrape off the polish. I usually have to put this on, wait about 10 minutes, scrape off what I can off, and then reapply a 2nd coat. With the proper tools, this stuff def works and saves me from having to pay the salon to remove it for me.

Worked well! Will buy again I did have to do two coats on a couple nails but it’s way better than soaking off gel nails! Buy the two pack you have to use a good bit, it’s very thick. Didn’t ruin my natural nails. Although I did notice where I got it on my skin when I went to repaint my nails and put them under the UV light it got really hot where it touched my skin.

reviews.t: Does the job! Would buy again.
reviews.x: Didn't work like the directions made it seem. I ended up using something to scrap the polish off after sitting for the allotted time, rather than wiping it off like they said. But it did the job I wanted it to and removed my proffesional gel manicure with minimal effort and no damage. Overall, happy with my purchase and would definitely buy again.

I wasn't impressed. It's easy to brush on like polish, it starts bubbling up immediately,  but it does very little to remove gel polish unless you reapply several times. It's a pain, but using acetone-soaked cotton balls and foil will remove gel polish much quicker and more effectively. I tried it and now I know.

I followed the instructions and this did not work as advertised. I thought this would be a great alternative to the traditional method of gel removal, but this was disappointing as this did not remove my gel polish. I tried 3x and still no result. Don’t waste your time or money on this product.

I was skeptical of this purchase. I couldn't imagine something so simple would do the job. Well, I was definitely wrong. This gel remover is amazing! In no time it was completely off. I used gauze pads purchased from Amazon and it worked exactly as expected. You're going to love it!

claims.text: Many reviewers say it removes gel polish quickly and easily, often within minutes.
Several reviewers note the product is very thick or clumpy, which some find hard to apply evenly while others consider it intended.
Some reviewers report needing multiple coats and that the bottle runs out quickly.
A few reviewers say it did not remove polish well, leaving it sticky or requiring filing.
Some reviewers complain about damaged nails or a product that arrived hardened and could not be returned.
